source: Point-in-time backtest: the stocks in the S&P 500 at each date from the real daily member lists, with prices for former members where data exists (56% of members in 2000, 82% in 2010, 90% in 2015, 97% since 2020; most of the rest went bankrupt or were bought out before 2010, which likely flatters the early years; EP and CPWR left out for reused tickers), news gaps, 0.15% slippage a trade, TLT / GLD spliced onto a Treasury fund / gold futures before they existed.
